The [[Bar Jaraniz]] [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcaf]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] served an elaborate '''cocktail''' as part of the seedy establishment's selection of beverages. The [[Cocktail/Legends|cocktail]] was crafted using a number of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] segments, several skewers, and a measure of sky-[[Color/Legends|blue]], two-hundred-proof [[Vosh/Legends|vosh]] poured from a bottle laden with lumps of floating [[geref]]. Bar Jaraniz's [[Unidentified Bar Jaraniz bartender|bartender]] was versed in creating the cocktail at his customers' request, and did so for one patron in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]].<ref name="APM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The elaborate cocktail served at Bar Jaraniz was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the [[New Jedi Order era]] [[EBook|e-novella]] entitled ''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]'', written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published in [[August]], [[2006]].<ref name="APM" />
